name: ARM CIRCLES
introduce: Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height. \n\nMove your arms forward in circles, and then move backwards.

tips.text: Your arms should go from small circles to big circles.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.
This exercise really helps loosen up your shoulders.
This is a great exercise to build arm muscle endurance.
